_comment: Full label extent (the label box: vast/launch.py --job label), not a training config: the full runs train on configs/full/data-*.json, built on this extent's labels. extent: the label set (kitsune/extent.py); inputs {} takes every upstream input of every named source. All label roots and the selection lie under extent.root (labels/full, write-once on the Hub). selection_recipe: the label box's selection (scripts/make_selection.py --config configs/full.json). label: the label box's settings (vast/label.py); workers 'auto' is computed from the box's effective cores.
